title: Application of the light touch regime under the Procurement Act 2023
description: Find out more about the essentials of the Procurement Act 2023 and its impact on Contract Management, transitioning from PCR 2015. Learn how contract extension and implementation strategies are evolving within modern procurement frameworks.
